title: C1: naïve participants, high effort
caption: Experimental results. (A) Average response in the four experimental conditions. (B) Median slider value plotted as a function of the true value of the tracked probability. The error bars indicate the interquartile range. (C) Median values of four summary statistics, split by condition. The error bars indicate the 25% and 75% quantiles. The title of each plot specifies the quantity on the y-axis. RMSE stands for root mean square error and KL stands for Kullback- Leibler. The dashed lines indicate the expected value of the summary statistic for an observer who responds randomly and an observer who always responds 0.50.
